processes.title: BDOIR End-to-End
processes.summary: The umbrella flow that chains new business, cashiering, collections, remittance, disbursement, the general ledger, renewal and claims. Each link is captured in detail in its own process below; these screens show the control points that tie the chain together.

steps.step: Executive dashboard: KPIs across the whole chain (in force, in placement, unapplied payments, pending approvals, disbursements in flight, past-TAT requests)
Single maker-checker queue for bookings, endorsements, journals, disbursements, CTE, claim settlements, EB awards and product changes
Production, collection and claims reports with CSV export
Client onboarding with sanctions screening, PEP flag and risk tiering feeding every process
Twelve personas with module entitlements and approver rights (segregation of duties)
Legacy data migration batches with load, reconciliation and disposition

processes.title: New Business
processes.summary: Client creation and screening, quotation, proposal, placement to the insurer, e-policy and booking under maker-checker.

steps.step: MAO creates the client in Broker; KYC details captured
steps.screen: Sanction Screening & Risk › New client form

steps.step: Client is sanction-screened automatically (clear / hit) and risk-tiered
steps.note: Screening result and CDD level shown on the row

steps.step: Quotation prepared with the rating engine (premium, VAT, DST, LGT, commission)
steps.screen: New Business › Quotations & proposals › New quotation form

steps.step: Quotation created (status: quoted); hold cover can be requested from the insurer
Proposal sent to the client by email (status: proposal sent)
steps.screen: New Business › Quotations & proposals › Send proposal

steps.step: Client acceptance recorded (Y); a decline with reason is the N branch
steps.screen: New Business › Quotations & proposals › Client accepted

steps.step: Placement requested: placement slip goes to the insurer via SFTP or email
Placement board tracks slips awaiting the insurer, returns and e-policies
Insurer placed the risk; e-policy received (COG via SFTP or PO email)
steps.screen: New Business › Placement › Placed / e-policy received

steps.step: Booking and invoicing raised for checker approval (maker-checker)
Underwriting Head (checker) reviews the booking request
Booking approved: invoice, journal and e-policy dispatch are posted automatically
Policy register: the policy is in force with its invoice and e-policy channel
Policy detail: placement history, e-policy status and the exception route to the contact centre

processes.title: Operations
processes.summary: Cashiering channels, post-dated cheque hold, unapplied premium, direct payments with commission receivables, adjustments and production reconciliation.

steps.step: Cashiering: open invoices (premium receivables) awaiting payment
Receive payment: channel (bills payment, OTC cash/cheque, batch files, autopay) and reference
Cheque payment recorded and held for the 4-day clearing period
PDC register: held cheques, matured, bounced (exclusion list) and unapplied premium
Held cheque shows Matured / Bounced actions once the 4-day hold lapses
steps.screen: Operations › Payments / PDC / UPP › Held cheque

steps.step: Cash / bills payment applied in full: official receipt issued and receivable cleared
Payment with zero PR / payment greater than PR is recorded without an invoice
steps.screen: Operations › Invoices & cashiering › Payment without invoice

steps.step: The amount sits in Unapplied Premium (GL 2400) until applied to an invoice
Direct payment to insurer identified for a booked policy
Commission receivable (GL 1250) billed to the insurer; follow-up until collected
Commission collected: commission official receipt issued
Adjustment / cancellation validated by the Adjustment Team and routed to the checker-poster
Endorsement pending checker approval; a refund creates a Refund Request Form (RRF) on approval
Production reconciliation: insurer production file matched against booked policies
Rows classified as matched, with discrepancies, or unbooked; each gets a disposition
Checker-poster reviews the endorsement
Endorsement posted: premium and commission reversed, RRF raised for the refund

processes.title: Marketing Collections
processes.summary: Premium receivable list by stage, marketing diary, credit-term extension under approval and statement of account.

steps.step: PR list: newly booked accounts to collect within 10–15 days; ageing and collection stage per invoice
Statement of account sent to the client
Marketing diary: when / where / how / what of each collection effort, commitment date and arrangement
Commitment beyond the 60-day credit term: MAO informed, tagged as committed
Credit-term extension (CTE) requested for Unit Head approval
Effort diary per invoice with category tagging
Unit / Finance Head reviews the CTE request
CTE approved: due date extended and account stays within term

processes.title: FRBS Accounting
processes.summary: Chart of accounts, system-generated journals, manual entries under review, trial balance, period and year-end closing.

steps.step: System-generated journals (booking, receipts, commissions) and manual entry form routed to the TL for posting
Trial balance and financial reports generated from the ledger
EOD / EOM / EOY: period close and reopen, fiscal-year close to retained earnings

processes.title: Disbursement
processes.summary: Disbursement chain DPO → DTL → DSH → DUH with segregation of duties, payment posting and confirmation email; weekly remittance to insurers.

steps.step: Weekly remittance extract of applied payments per insurer, sanitised and submitted to Disbursement
Disbursement request (DPO) with payee, amount, mode and bank details
Request awaits a reviewer other than the maker (segregation of duties)
Team lead review (DTL) OK; routed to the Finance Head for approval
Finance Head (DSH / DUH) reviews the voucher
Approved; ready for payment
Payment posted with cheque reference; status tagged paid and confirmation email sent

processes.title: Refund Request
processes.summary: Refund Request Form raised from a cancellation, TL review, Unit Head sign-off and hand-off to the disbursement chain.

steps.step: RRF register: refund raised by the endorsement with amount, mode and reason
Marketing TL reviews the RRF
steps.screen: Accounting & Disbursement › Refund requests › TL review OK

steps.step: Unit Head sign-off: a disbursement request is created for the refund
steps.screen: Accounting & Disbursement › Refund requests › UH approve

steps.step: Refund enters the disbursement chain (review → approve → pay)

processes.title: ACSL (Insurer SOA reconciliation)
processes.summary: Insurer statement of account reconciled against the ledger; abnormal balances raise adjustment entries reviewed by the TL and posted by the FRBS approver.

steps.step: Insurer SOA lines captured against the ledger
Variances flagged (abnormal balances, unknown items) for manual subsidiary-ledger adjustment
steps.screen: Accounting & Disbursement › ACSL / SOA recon › Result

processes.title: Claims
processes.summary: Notice of loss, PLA, document checklist, FLA to the insurer, evaluation and offer, contest loop, settlement approval and closure.

steps.step: Notice of loss registered against the policy (Claims Acceptance Control checks premium status)
Preliminary Loss Advice (PLA) sent; claim opened with reserve
Document checklist by line (motor / non-motor); FLA blocked until complete
All requirements received: documents complete
Formal Loss Advice sent to the insurer; adjuster inspection flagged
Insurer evaluation and offer received
Insured contests the offer; re-evaluation loop with the insurer
Settlement by LOA to casa/dealer or cash requested for approval
steps.screen: Claims › Claim detail › Request settlement approval

steps.step: Approver reviews the settlement
Settlement approved
Claim tagged settled / paid, then closed; declination is the alternative exit

processes.title: Case Management (To-Be)
processes.pdf: CASE MANAGEMENT TO BE PROCESS FLOW_07152026.pdf
processes.summary: General vs account-related inquiries, positive identification, point-of-contact handling or referral to the fulfilment unit, TAT monitoring and return to CCC.

steps.step: Contact logged: general inquiry (no client) vs account-related concern
General inquiry handled and closed at point of contact
Account-related concern: positive identification (PID) and routing to the owning unit with a TAT
Case referred to the fulfilment unit; TAT due time computed and past-TAT flagged
Case returned to the Customer Contact Centre for re-logging with a reason
steps.screen: Customer Servicing › Cases › Return to CCC

steps.step: Case re-logged and back in the open queue

processes.title: Customer Servicing Facility
processes.summary: Search by invoice, policy or client name; view policies, invoices and receipts; update contact details.

steps.step: Servicing facility: search by invoice no., policy no. or client name
Client contact details updated from the facility
steps.screen: Customer Servicing › Servicing facility › Update contact

processes.title: Renewal (RMEL)
processes.summary: Renewal master expiry list 140 days out, sanitation and disposition, initial and final RA letters, client acceptance and renewal placement.

steps.step: RMEL: policies expiring within 140 days, pending sanitation
Sanitation: disposition for renewal / remarket / not for renewal (NRNS letter)
Initial renewal advice letter sent 70 days before expiry
Final renewal advice letter sent 45 days before expiry
Client accepted: renewal policy enters placement and the e-policy cycle

processes.title: Reinsurance
processes.summary: Facultative request with 24-hour acknowledgement and 3-day slip TAT, underwriting information loop, reinsurer security rating, signed slips, closing and debit note; treaties and cessions.

steps.step: Facultative placement request from marketing with the risk details
Request logged; acknowledgement due within 24 hours (TAT flag)
Acknowledged; slip due within 3 working days
Slip: reinsurers approached with security rating, share and signed-slip evidence
Closing: placement closed and debit note issued to the cedant
Treaty register and cessions with capacity monitoring

processes.title: Submitted Policies
processes.summary: Masterlist validation, matching and consolidation, adequacy review with IAAF findings, and hand-off to sanitation 150 days from expiry.

steps.step: Masterlist upload from the bank / insurer for validation and matching
Rows validated, matched and consolidated; each reviewed for adequacy
steps.screen: Submitted Policies › Masterlist batches › Run pipeline

steps.step: Findings recorded and an Insurance Adequacy Assessment Form (IAAF) issued
Policies 150 days from expiry sent to the sanitation handler for renewal / conversion opportunity

processes.title: Employee Benefits
processes.summary: Renewal advice, BOR, TOR with master list and utilisation released to insurers, comparative analysis, award with ISACOM for non-accredited providers, handoff.

steps.step: Prospect scheme created from the renewal advice
Broker of Record received, Terms of Reference prepared, member census uploaded
TOR, master list and utilisation released to insurers (franchise)
steps.screen: Employee Benefits › Release TOR to insurers

steps.step: Comparative analysis of proposals: premium, benefits and capabilities
Client confirmation and award; ISACOM approval when the provider is not accredited; handoff to processing and collections

processes.title: Product Maintenance (TSU)
processes.summary: Technical Services Unit request for non-packaged risks: completeness and duplicate check, quotation slip, TL approval, RI referral, insurer responses, comparative table and proposal slip; package maintenance with release advisory.

steps.step: PRF / TSU request for a non-packaged risk with completeness and duplicate check
TSU acknowledges the request (or returns it as incomplete)
Quotation slip prepared and approved by the TL
steps.screen: Product Maintenance › TSU detail › TL approve QS

steps.step: RI referral cleared; quotation slip sent to insurers
steps.screen: Product Maintenance › TSU detail › Send QS to insurers

steps.step: Insurer responses recorded (accepted with evidence / declined / conditional); comparative table ready
steps.screen: Product Maintenance › TSU detail › Comparative table

steps.step: Proposal slip approved with the selected insurer; released to marketing and the client
steps.screen: Product Maintenance › TSU detail › Approve proposal slip

steps.step: Packaged product catalogue with rates, taxes and limits
Package maintenance request raised for validation and approval
Approver validates the product change
Change applied and a release advisory published
Insurer panel with accreditation and SFTP enrolment for placement channels
